name: Global Studies
overview: Global Studies is an interdisciplinary field that examines the interconnected political, economic, cultural, social, and environmental forces shaping the modern world. It emphasizes understanding how nations and societies influence one another through globalization, international relations, development, human rights, and cultural exchange. The field draws from political science, economics, sociology, history, geography, anthropology, and environmental studies. Professionals work in international organizations, NGOs, think tanks, government agencies, and research institutes.
topQualities: Language Skills and Willingness to Learn

topJobs.description: Supports foreign policy analysis, diplomacy, international cooperation, and geopolitical assessments across governments, embassies, think tanks, and NGOs.
Researches and evaluates global issues like development, security, and climate change to support evidence-based policymaking across organizations.
Designs and manages programs addressing global challenges in education, healthcare, poverty reduction, and sustainability across NGOs and multilateral agencies.
Represents countries in foreign capitals, engages in international negotiations, and manages bilateral/multilateral relations through embassies and consulates.

institutesIndia: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai
institutesInternational: Johns Hopkins SAIS (School of Advanced International Studies)
careerLadder: Secondary/high school foundation in political science, history, geography, economics, sociology; develop communication and language skills
Bachelor's degree in Global Studies, International Relations, Political Science, or related field; pursue internships with NGOs and think tanks
Entry-level roles: program coordinator, research assistant, policy assistant, international project officer, communications associate, development associate
Master's degree in Global Studies, International Relations, Public Policy, or Development Studies for specialization
Mid-level positions: policy analyst, international development manager, regional program lead, global strategy consultant, humanitarian project manager
Senior roles: diplomat, senior policy advisor, director of international programs, country head for NGOs, leadership in international organizations
Advanced paths: academia/research, global media, international advocacy, corporate leadership with international focus
